briefdescription.para: Image decode and SKiT filepath handler — implementation.

detaileddescription.para: Implements Skit::processDCS(), Skit::processAPC(), Skit::processOSC1337(), and Skit::handleSkitFilepath(). All decode logic that previously lived in VideoDCS.cpp and VideoOSCExt.cpp has been consolidated here so that image decoding is separated from VT command processing.

simplesect.title: Image pipeline (all three protocols share the same commit path)

listitem.para: Receive raw payload + cursor position from Processor command handler.
On SKiT: fire "previewFile" event and return.
On image: decode with protocol-specific decoder.
Compute cell span from pixel dimensions and cellWidth / cellHeight.
Fire "imageDecoded" event with pixel data and placement metadata.
Set lastImageRows so Processor can advance the cursor via Video.

simplesect.title: Thread model
simplesect.para: All methods run exclusively on the READER THREAD. All methods run on the READER THREAD, including setCellSize().
